mechanics.claim: Lightning Rounds Burst Fire bonus damage on first hit increases with the caster's critical strike damage.
Secondary target damage from pierce does not apply on-hit effects or lifesteal, nor trigger on-attack effects, but is affected by critical strike modifiers.
mechanics.quote: Targets after the first take modified damage which does not apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects or {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} nor trigger {{tip|on-attack}} effects, but is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.

mechanics.claim: Spark Surge's cooldown starts on cast.
Spark Surge resets Zeri's basic attack timer and Burst Fire's cooldown.
mechanics.quote: Spark Surge {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Zeri's''' basic attack timer and {{ais|Burst Fire|Zeri}} cooldown.

mechanics.claim: Q (Burst Fire) is disabled during the dash, while W and R remain usable.
